dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: Greetings, traveler from afar! We, the Frostmoon Scions, bid you welcome. May the light of the Moon Goddess guide you on your way!

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: I am Zirnytsia, humble acolyte and servant to the Frost Moon. My duty is to guide visiting travelers and share with them the grace of Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar.

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: If you wish to visit the Lady Moonchanter, please talk to Ehrnrooth. If you're here to discuss business, then you should have a word with Uncle Krodo. If you'd simply like to pray, Vernadska should be around here somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: And of course, if you need any assistance, or you're looking for somewhere to rest your weary feet, don't hesitate to let me know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about yourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: We are the loyal servants of Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar. Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar is the guardian of kindness and warmth, the sole light amid the darkness, and she is most generous in answering our prayers...

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: In this dark and desolate land, only moonlight can bring peace and tranquility.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about yourselves...

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: We are the loyal servants of Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar. No matter what choices Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar makes, no matter whether our hymns remain unanswered, she is the deity we follow.

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: In this dark and desolate land, only moonlight can bring peace and tranquility.

dialogues.speaker: Zirnytsia
dialogues.text: May the moon forever light your path!
